description: This file defines a SwiftUI view 'SystemRunSettingsView' and related classes, models, and subviews for managing system run settings and execution approval configurations within a macOS app. It includes UI components, state handling, and data logic for agent selection, security policies, allowlist management, and more.

classes.name: ExecApprovalsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state and logic for execution approval settings, including agent management, security policies, allowlist entries, and skill bins.

classes.name: ExecAllowlistRow
classes.description: A SwiftUI view representing a row in the allowlist list, allowing editing and removal of allowlist entries.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes agent list and loads settings for the current agent, also refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: refreshAgents
methods.description: Loads the list of agents from configuration store and updates internal state.

methods.name: selectAgent
methods.description: Selects an agent by ID, updates settings and refreshes skill bins.

methods.name: loadSettings
methods.description: Loads approval settings for a specified agent ID.

methods.name: setSecurity
methods.description: Updates security setting and persists it.

methods.name: setAsk
methods.description: Updates ask policy setting and persists it.

methods.name: setAskFallback
methods.description: Updates fallback security mode and persists it.

methods.name: setAutoAllowSkills
methods.description: Enables or disables auto-allow for skill CLI patterns and updates skill bins.

methods.name: addEntry
methods.description: Adds a new allowlist pattern after validation.

methods.name: updateEntry
methods.description: Updates an existing allowlist entry after validation.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: entry
methods.description: Retrieves an allowlist entry by ID.

methods.name: isPathPattern
methods.description: Checks whether a pattern is a valid path pattern.

methods.name: refreshSkillBins
methods.description: Fetches current skill bin categories, optionally forcing refresh.
